parsed.elsewhere_quote: Therefore \(\Gamma=\delta\). Xiang has at most \(n=(n+1)-1\) cuts, so the lower half of the refinement lemma gives \(D\ge\delta\) for every one of his marking choices.
parsed.explanation: The objection is correct: the cumulative cut positions for lengths \(\delta,2\delta,\ldots,2^n\delta\) are \((2^j-1)\delta\), not \(2^j\delta\). However, (9) correctly specifies the intended division, and the proved refinement lemma plus the binary subset-sum calculation establishes the universal lower bound. The erroneous position formula is unused. Inserting “\(-1\)” repairs it.
